lessons.title: 展示原型并收集意见
lines: Could I show you a quick prototype of the new screen?
我能快速演示一下新页面的原型吗？
prototype＝供讨论思路的原型，不一定是正式产品
Yes, I'd like to see how the flow works.
可以，我想看看整个操作流程。
flow＝用户完成任务的操作路径
What's the first thing a user would do here?
用户在这里第一步会做什么？
first thing＝第一步动作
They'd select a project and choose a date range.
他们会先选择项目，再选日期范围。
date range＝起止日期区间
Can we try it with some realistic sample data?
能用更接近实际的示例数据试试吗？
realistic sample data＝贴近业务的数据样本
Of course. I'll load a typical customer case.
当然，我会加载一个典型客户场景。
typical case＝有代表性的案例
This is only a draft, so I'd welcome feedback.
这还只是初稿，很欢迎提意见。
I'd welcome feedback＝礼貌邀请反馈
I'm not convinced the button label is clear enough.
我觉得按钮文字可能还不够清楚。
not convinced＝尚不确定或不完全认可
We could simplify the page before adding more options.
可以先简化页面，再增加更多选项。
before adding＝先做前面的事
I'll revise the prototype and share another version.
我会调整原型，再分享一版。
revise＝根据反馈修改

lessons.title: 健身房咨询单次入场
lessons.english: Asking About a Gym Day Pass
lines: Hello, do you offer a day pass for visitors?
你好，你们有访客单日入场票吗？
day pass＝单日使用资格
Yes, you can pay for a single visit at reception.
有，您可以在前台支付单次费用。
single visit＝只使用一次
Does the pass include the swimming pool?
这个票包含游泳池吗？
include＝收费中已包含
The pool has a separate entry fee.
泳池需要另付入场费。
separate fee＝单独收费
Are there any quieter times in the evening?
晚上有没有人少一点的时段？
quieter times＝相对不那么繁忙的时段
It's usually less busy after eight.
一般八点以后人会少些。
less busy＝较不拥挤
Do I need to bring a padlock for the locker?
储物柜需要自己带锁吗？
padlock＝挂锁；locker＝储物柜
Could you show me where the changing rooms are?
能告诉我更衣室在哪里吗？
changing rooms＝更衣室
I'll start with a short workout today.
我今天先简单练一会儿。
workout＝一次锻炼
Thanks. I'll have a look around before deciding.
谢谢，我决定前先看看环境。
have a look around＝四处看看

lessons.title: 发现数据质量问题
lines: I've noticed some gaps in yesterday's data.
我发现昨天的数据有几处缺失。
gaps＝数据中缺少的部分
Do you know which records are affected?
你知道哪些记录受影响吗？
affected＝受到问题影响
It seems to be limited to one source system.
目前看似乎只涉及一个源系统。
limited to＝影响范围局限于
Could we confirm that before changing anything?
修改之前能先确认一下吗？
before changing anything＝避免过早采取有风险的修复
What's our best way to check the raw data?
怎样核对原始数据最合适？
raw data＝未经当前处理流程加工的数据
We can compare it with the source export.
可以和源系统导出的数据比对。
source export＝来源系统导出结果
I'd rather fix the cause than patch the numbers.
我更愿意修复原因，而不是临时改数字。
patch the numbers＝为掩盖问题而临时修补结果
Let's record which reports might be inaccurate.
把可能不准确的报表记录下来吧。
might be inaccurate＝可能不准确，尚需证实
We should flag this before the next business review.
下次业务评审前应主动说明此事。
flag＝主动提醒相关风险
I'll share the findings once we've checked the source.
核实来源后，我会分享发现。
findings＝检查得到的结论

lessons.title: 周末城市步行游览
lines: Is this area easy to explore on foot?
这片区域适合步行游览吗？
on foot＝步行
Yes, most of the sights are close together.
适合，大多数景点距离很近。
sights＝值得参观的地方
How long would the whole walk take?
走完整条路线需要多久？
the whole walk＝整个步行路线
Allow about two hours if you stop for photos.
如果会停下来拍照，预留约两小时。
allow two hours＝为活动预留两小时
Could we start somewhere near the station?
我们能从车站附近开始吗？
somewhere near＝某个接近目标的地点
That would make it easier to get back later.
这样之后返程更方便。
get back＝返回出发地
Is there a nice place to stop for coffee?
途中有适合喝咖啡的地方吗？
stop for coffee＝中途歇脚喝咖啡
I'd prefer a route with fewer busy roads.
我更喜欢少穿过繁忙马路的路线。
fewer＝数量更少
Let's keep the afternoon fairly relaxed.
下午的安排轻松一点吧。
fairly relaxed＝不赶时间
Could you mark the starting point on the map?
能在地图上标出起点吗？
starting point＝出发点

lessons.title: 整理客户反馈
lines: Can we go through the feedback from the pilot?
能一起看看试点阶段的反馈吗？
pilot＝小范围试运行
Most users found the new screen easier to navigate.
多数用户认为新页面更容易操作。
navigate＝在界面中找到要操作的内容
Which problems came up more than once?
哪些问题被重复提到了？
came up＝在讨论或反馈中出现
Several people struggled with the export settings.
有几个人不太会使用导出设置。
struggle with＝使用时感到困难
Do we know how serious that is for daily work?
我们知道这对日常工作影响多大吗？
how serious＝严重程度
It slows down their end-of-day reporting.
它拖慢了他们每日收尾报表的工作。
slow down＝降低速度或效率
Let's separate urgent issues from general suggestions.
我们把紧急问题与普通建议分开吧。
separate … from＝进行分类区分
I'd like to speak to two users before we decide.
决定前我想再找两位用户聊聊。
before we decide＝不要过早决定
Could we share a short summary with the customer?
能向客户发一个简短总结吗？
share a summary＝提供重点归纳
I'll update the priorities based on what we learn.
我会根据了解的情况调整优先级。
based on＝以某些信息为依据

lessons.title: 餐厅分开结账
lines: Would it be possible to split the bill, please?
请问可以分开结账吗？
split the bill＝把账单分开支付
Of course. How would you like to split it?
当然，您希望怎么分？
how would you like＝礼貌询问具体方式
Could we each pay for what we ordered?
我们能各自付自己点的菜吗？
each pay for＝分别支付自己的消费
Yes, I'll separate the items on the till.
可以，我在收银系统里把各项分开。
till＝英国店铺的收银机或收银系统
I had the soup and the sparkling water.
我点的是汤和气泡水。
sparkling water＝带气的水
Thanks. That comes to twelve pounds fifty.
谢谢，这一份是12.50英镑。
comes to＝总计多少钱
Can I pay my part by card?
我这部分能刷卡吗？
my part＝我应付的那一份
Could I have a separate receipt as well?
我还能单独拿一张收据吗？
as well＝同时也需要
Shall we check that nothing has been missed?
我们核对一下有没有漏掉项目？
been missed＝被遗漏
That looks right. Thank you very much.
没问题，非常感谢。
looks right＝看起来金额正确

lessons.title: 协商可交付时间
lines: Could we review the proposed delivery date?
我们能重新看一下建议的交付日期吗？
proposed＝目前提出但未最终确认的
Is there a particular reason it needs to be Friday?
一定要周五交付，有什么特别原因吗？
particular reason＝具体理由
The customer wants to test it before the weekend.
客户希望周末前测试。
before the weekend＝在周末到来之前
We might need another day for proper verification.
我们可能还需要一天做充分验证。
proper verification＝足够完整的验证
Could we deliver the core feature first?
我们能先交付核心功能吗？
core feature＝最关键的功能
That could work if the remaining items are clearly listed.
只要剩余事项列得清楚，可能可行。
could work＝可能是可行方案
I don't want to promise a date we can't meet.
我不想承诺一个做不到的日期。
meet a date＝按承诺日期完成
Let's agree what can safely be deferred.
我们确认哪些工作可以安全地延期吧。
deferred＝推迟处理
I'll send an updated estimate with the assumptions.
我会发送带有前提条件的新估时。
assumptions＝估算赖以成立的假设
Can we confirm the decision in writing?
能否用书面形式确认决定？
in writing＝以文字记录

lessons.title: 药店咨询用药说明
lines: Could you help me understand the directions on this label?
能帮我看懂标签上的使用说明吗？
directions＝用药说明，不是地图方向
Of course. Which part is unclear?
当然，哪部分不清楚？
unclear＝含义不明确
Does it say to take this with food?
这里是说要随餐服用吗？
with food＝和食物一起；须按药师确认的说明执行
Let me check the exact instructions with you.
我和您一起核对准确说明。
exact instructions＝针对这款药的具体说明
Is there anything I should avoid while taking it?
服用期间有什么应该避免的吗？
avoid＝避免某种活动或食物
The pharmacist can talk you through any precautions.
药师可以为您逐项解释注意事项。
talk you through＝一步步讲解
Could I speak to the pharmacist directly?
我能直接和药师沟通吗？
pharmacist＝药师，能提供专业用药建议
I'd rather check than make an assumption.
我宁愿确认一下，也不想凭猜测用药。
make an assumption＝未经核实就作出判断
Can you write down the advice for me?
可以把建议写给我吗？
write down＝写成文字便于核对
Thanks. I'll follow the instructions on the label.
谢谢，我会按标签说明使用。
follow the instructions＝按照具体说明操作

lessons.title: 排查API对接问题
lines: Are we getting a response from the API at all?
这个API现在有返回响应吗？
at all＝到底有没有，强调基本情况
Yes, but the status code is not what we expect.
有，但状态码不是预期的。
status code＝表示请求结果的HTTP状态码
Could you share the request you used for testing?
能分享一下测试时发送的请求吗？
request＝发送到接口的请求数据
I'll remove any secrets before sharing it.
分享前我会去掉敏感密钥。
secrets＝令牌、密码等敏感凭证
Does the issue happen in both test and production?
测试环境和生产环境都会发生吗？
production＝面向真实业务运行的环境
No, we've only seen it in the test environment.
没有，目前只在测试环境出现。
only seen＝观察范围仅限于
Let's compare the configuration on both sides.
我们比较一下双方的配置。
on both sides＝通信或集成的双方
We should check the timeout before changing the retry logic.
改重试逻辑前应先查超时设置。
timeout＝允许等待响应的时间上限
Can we capture one failing example with a timestamp?
能记录一个带时间戳的失败样本吗？
timestamp＝事件发生的具体时间
I'll document the fix once the integration passes.
集成测试通过后我会记录修复方法。
document the fix＝将解决方法写入文档

lessons.title: 理发预约与沟通
lines: Hello, have you got any appointments this afternoon?
您好，今天下午还有预约时段吗？
have you got＝英式常见询问是否有
We have an opening at half past three.
我们三点半有空档。
an opening＝可预约的空档
How long does a basic haircut usually take?
普通理发通常要多久？
basic haircut＝一般剪发服务
About half an hour, depending on the style.
大约半小时，具体看发型。
depending on＝取决于
I'd just like a tidy-up, nothing too short.
我只想稍微修整一下，不要剪太短。
tidy-up＝小幅修剪整理
Would you like us to wash your hair first?
您想先洗头吗？
wash your hair＝洗头发
Could you take a little off the sides?
两侧能稍微剪短一点吗？
take a little off＝剪掉一点长度
Please keep the top a bit longer.
顶部请保留长一些。
a bit longer＝稍微长一点
That looks good. Could I check the back as well?
这样不错，我还能看看后面吗？
check the back＝查看后脑勺的修剪效果
Thanks, I'm happy with that length.
谢谢，这个长度我很满意。
happy with＝对结果满意

lessons.title: 讨论技术债优先级
lines: Should we set aside time for the old module?
我们要不要为旧模块专门留点时间？
set aside time＝预留时间
What problems is it causing at the moment?
它目前带来了哪些问题？
at the moment＝目前
It's making simple changes take much longer.
它让一些简单改动花了很久。
make … take longer＝导致耗时增加
Do we have examples of the extra effort?
有额外工作量的具体例子吗？
extra effort＝增加的成本
Yes, every release needs manual checks in three places.
有，每次发布都得在三个地方人工检查。
manual checks＝需要人去确认的步骤
That sounds worth addressing before the next big feature.
这听起来值得在下个大功能前处理。
worth addressing＝值得着手解决
Let's estimate the risk of leaving it as it is.
我们估算一下保持现状的风险。
leave it as it is＝暂时不作改变
We don't need a complete rewrite to improve it.
要改善它不一定需要全部重写。
complete rewrite＝整体重新开发
Could we start by adding a few focused tests?
能先加几个针对性测试吗？
focused tests＝针对具体风险点的测试
I'll suggest a small improvement we can measure.
我会提出一个效果可衡量的小改进。
we can measure＝可以用指标判断效果

lessons.title: 酒店早餐时间与选择
lines: Is breakfast included in my room rate?
房费里包含早餐吗？
room rate＝酒店房间价格
Yes, it is. Breakfast is served downstairs.
包含，早餐在楼下供应。
served＝在某处供应餐食
What time does breakfast finish on weekdays?
工作日早餐几点结束？
finish＝供应结束，不一定是关闭餐厅
At ten, but it gets busy before nine.
十点结束，不过九点前会很忙。
gets busy＝人逐渐多起来
Do you have any dairy-free options?
有不含乳制品的选择吗？
dairy-free＝不含乳制品
There's fruit and toast, but please check the labels.
有水果和吐司，但请核对标签。
check the labels＝看食物说明以确认适用性
Could I take a coffee away with me?
我可以把咖啡带走吗？
take away＝外带
Do I need to give my room number at the entrance?
进餐厅时要报房号吗？
give my room number＝告知房号
I have an early train, so I'd like to eat quickly.
我得赶早班火车，所以想快点吃。
early train＝早班列车
Thanks. I'll come down just after seven.
谢谢，我七点过一点就下来。
just after＝刚过某个时间

lessons.title: 主持技术讨论工作坊
lines: Thanks for joining today's workshop.
谢谢大家参加今天的讨论会。
workshop＝共同讨论、实践和产出成果的工作会议
Can we start by agreeing what we need to decide?
先确认今天要决定哪些问题，好吗？
agree what to decide＝先统一目标
We'd like to leave with a clear technical direction.
我们希望会议结束时技术方向明确。
leave with＝结束时带着某项成果
That sounds good. Who's capturing the decisions?
听起来不错，谁负责记录决定？
capture decisions＝将决策整理成记录
Could everyone briefly share their main concern?
能请大家简要说说主要担忧吗？
main concern＝最关心的问题
I'm worried about how we'll handle peak traffic.
我担心高峰流量的处理方式。
peak traffic＝流量高峰
Let's put that on the board for discussion.
我们把它写到讨论板上吧。
put on the board＝放进共同讨论内容
We don't have to solve every detail today.
今天不必解决所有细节。
every detail＝全部细枝末节
I'd like to keep the conversation focused on the key choices.
我希望讨论集中在关键选项上。
keep focused＝避免话题跑偏
We'll finish by assigning owners and next steps.
最后我们会确定负责人和后续行动。
assign owners＝明确责任人

lessons.title: 电影院买票与选座
lines: Have you got two seats for the evening showing?
晚场还有两个座位吗？
showing＝某场次电影放映
Yes, there are a few seats near the back.
有，靠后还有几个位置。
near the back＝靠近后排
Are those seats next to each other?
那些座位挨着吗？
next to each other＝相邻
These two are together, in row H.
这两个连在一起，在H排。
row＝座位排号
Does the film have subtitles?
这部电影有字幕吗？
subtitles＝画面上的对白文字
Let me check the details for that screening.
我查一下那场的具体信息。
screening＝一场特定的放映
Could we collect the tickets at the cinema?
我们能到影院取票吗？
collect tickets＝领取预订票
How early should we arrive before it starts?
开场前我们应该提前多久到？
how early＝提前多长时间
I'd rather sit away from the front row.
我更想坐得离第一排远一点。
away from＝远离
Thanks, those seats will be fine.
谢谢，这两个座位可以。
will be fine＝可以接受

lessons.title: 总结研讨会结论
lines: Could we recap the decisions before we finish?
结束前能总结一下决定吗？
recap＝简要回顾要点
We've agreed to test the simpler approach first.
我们已决定先测试较简单的方案。
agreed to＝已一致同意去做
What still needs a decision from the customer?
还有什么需要客户拍板？
needs a decision＝尚未定案
The data retention period hasn't been confirmed.
数据保留期限还没确认。
retention period＝数据保留的时长
Who'll follow up on that point?
那一点由谁跟进？
follow up on＝后续继续推进
I'll take it and bring an answer to the next meeting.
我负责，下次会议给出答复。
take it＝接下这项任务
Let's make sure the owners are written down.
确保负责人都记录下来了。
written down＝写成正式记录
We should share the summary while it's still fresh.
趁大家记忆还清晰，尽快发总结。
while it's still fresh＝趁印象还深
Can everyone confirm the next steps by email?
大家能通过邮件确认后续步骤吗？
confirm by email＝书面确认
Thanks for a productive discussion today.
感谢大家今天高效的讨论。
productive＝有实际产出的

lessons.title: 航班登机口变化
lines: Excuse me, has the gate for this flight changed?
请问这班航班的登机口改了吗？
gate＝登机口
Yes, it's now departing from gate twenty-two.
是的，现在改为22号登机口。
departing from＝从某登机口出发
Is it far from here?
离这里远吗？
far from here＝与当前地点相距较远
It's about ten minutes on foot.
走过去大概十分钟。
on foot＝步行
Has the boarding time changed as well?
登机时间也变了吗？
as well＝也
The screens are showing the latest boarding information.
显示屏上有最新登机信息。
boarding information＝何时何地登机的更新
Could you point me towards the new gate?
能指一下新登机口的方向吗？
point me towards＝告诉大致方向
I'd better head over now to be safe.
保险起见，我最好现在过去。
to be safe＝为稳妥起见
Do you know whether there's a shuttle between terminals?
航站楼之间有摆渡车吗？
shuttle＝短距离接驳车
Thanks, I'll follow the airport signs.
谢谢，我会按照机场标识走。
follow the signs＝沿指示牌所指方向走

lessons.title: 讨论测试覆盖范围
lines: Which parts of the feature are covered by tests?
这个功能哪些部分有测试覆盖？
covered by tests＝已有测试会检查
We've tested the main flow and the common errors.
我们测了主流程和常见错误。
main flow＝用户主要操作路径
What about cases where the external service times out?
外部服务超时时怎么办？
times out＝超过等待时限
We haven't added that case yet.
那个情况还没有加进测试。
that case＝特定测试场景
Could we add one test for a failed connection?
能增加一个连接失败的测试吗？
failed connection＝未能建立或保持连接
Yes, it would help verify the retry behaviour.
可以，这能帮助验证重试行为。
retry behaviour＝失败后如何重试
I'd also like to check we don't duplicate requests.
我还想确认不会重复发请求。
duplicate requests＝重复提交同一操作
Let's prioritise the cases with the highest risk.
我们优先测风险最高的情况。
highest risk＝最可能造成严重影响
Can we show the remaining gaps in the test report?
测试报告能列出剩余空白吗？
remaining gaps＝尚未覆盖部分
I'll update the test list before the next build.
下次构建前我会更新测试清单。
next build＝下一次生成的程序版本

lessons.title: 挑选礼物与退换政策
lines: I'm looking for a small gift for a colleague.
我想给一位同事买份小礼物。
looking for＝在寻找
Would you prefer something practical or decorative?
您喜欢实用的还是装饰性的？
practical＝实用的
Something local would be nice, but not too expensive.
最好有点当地特色，但不要太贵。
something local＝当地特色物品
These chocolates are made nearby and are popular.
这些巧克力是附近生产的，很受欢迎。
made nearby＝在附近生产
Could you tell me how long they'll keep?
能告诉我能保存多久吗？
how long they'll keep＝食品保质时间，不是保存数据
The best-before date is printed on the back.
建议食用期限印在背面。
best-before＝品质最佳日期，不等同于安全保证
Is it possible to get this gift-wrapped?
可以帮我把它包装成礼物吗？
gift-wrapped＝礼品包装
Could I have a gift receipt without the price?
可以给我一张不显示价格的礼品收据吗？
gift receipt＝方便收礼人换货的收据
Do you offer exchanges if it isn't suitable?
如果不合适，可以换货吗？
exchanges＝换货
Thanks, I'll take this one.
谢谢，我就买这个。
take this one＝决定购买这个

lessons.title: 跨时区远程协作
lines: Could we find a meeting time that works for both teams?
能找一个两边团队都方便的会议时间吗？
works for＝对某方合适
Your morning would be late afternoon for us.
你们上午对应我们傍晚。
late afternoon＝下午较晚的时段
Would an earlier start be manageable for you?
你们能接受稍早一点开始吗？
manageable＝可以承受、安排得过来
Yes, as long as we keep it to half an hour.
可以，只要控制在半小时。
as long as＝条件是
Could we share the agenda before the call?
能在会议前分享议程吗？
before the call＝通话开始之前
That would let everyone prepare asynchronously.
这样大家就能异步提前准备。
asynchronously＝不同时间各自完成
Let's record the decision so nobody misses it.
我们记录下决定，免得有人错过。
miss it＝未收到关键信息
I don't want anyone to feel they must reply overnight.
我不希望大家觉得必须连夜回复。
overnight＝在夜间或过夜
Can we agree on normal response times?
能统一正常回复时限吗？
response times＝通常多久回应
I'll send the notes to both teams tomorrow.
我明天把记录发给两个团队。
both teams＝双方团队

lessons.title: 临时共享办公空间
lines: Do you have a desk available for just one day?
有只租一天的工位吗？
for just one day＝仅用一天
Yes, we offer day passes for visitors.
有，我们提供访客单日票。
day pass＝按日使用的凭证
Is there somewhere quiet to take a video call?
有没有安静的地方可以开视频会议？
take a video call＝进行视频通话
There's a phone booth you can book by the hour.
有一个电话间，可以按小时预约。
phone booth＝供私人通话的小隔间
Does the pass include reliable Wi-Fi?
单日票包含稳定的无线网络吗？
include＝费用中已涵盖
Yes, the network details are at reception.
有，网络信息可以在前台领取。
network details＝无线网络名称及接入信息
Could I use an external monitor at the desk?
这个工位能接外部显示器吗？
external monitor＝外接显示器
Is it all right to leave my bag here during lunch?
午饭时我可以把包留在这里吗？
all right to＝是否允许
What time do I need to leave by?
我最晚几点要离开？
by＝不晚于
Thanks, that sounds suitable for today.
谢谢，今天用这个很合适。
suitable＝符合需要
